heading: “Act”. “Omission”.
text: The word “act” denotes as well as series of acts as a single act: the word “omission” denotes as well a series of omissions as a single omission.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
